title: Longer greetings from wide starts
prompt: Three people start spread out. Person 1 and person 2 approach and share a friendly greeting with a handshake, then release. Person 2 then approaches person 3 for a longer friendly handshake and releases.

beats.prompt: Person 1 and person 2 greet each other with a friendly handshake, then release and stand comfortably.
Person 2 and person 3 greet each other with a friendly handshake, then release and stand comfortably.
